newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks rise, bolstered by Santander, Repsol.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks rise, bolstered by Santander, Repsol.

text.p: Madrid stocks ended sharply higher on Tuesday, bolstered by unexpectedly good first-quarter earnings at leading bank Santander and heavy volume from Repsol whose privatisation ended Monday.
The Madrid General index closed up 6.62 points, or 1.32 percent, at 507.79. The IBEX-index of leading shares closed up 80.88 points, or 1.4 percent, at 5,838.19, as Wall Street also powered higher.
Santander outpaced the market, rising 500 pesetas, or 4.85 percent to 10,810 after it announced Q1 net attributable rose 23.7 percent, much better than 21 percent analysts had expected.
Repsol captured 40 percent of market volume, ending 30 pesetas higher at 6,040.
